class.name: GodotDoctorResourceReport
class.brief_description: Holds validation results for a single resource.

method.name: _init
method.description: Creates a new [GodotDoctorResourceReport] for the resource at [param resource_path] with the given [param validation_messages].

method.name: get_num_infos
method.description: Returns the number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.INFO]-level validation messages for this resource.

method.name: get_num_warnings
method.description: Returns the number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.WARNING]-level validation messages for this resource.

method.name: get_num_errors
method.description: Returns the number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.ERROR]-level validation messages for this resource.

method.name: get_resource_path
method.description: Returns the path (or UID) of the validated resource.

method.name: get_validation_messages
method.description: Returns all validation messages associated with this resource.

members.member: The resource path (or UID) identifying the validated resource.
The list of validation messages associated with this resource.
